standards.name: NASA-STD-6001B Test 1 (upward flame propagation)
standards.summary: Pass/fail upward flame propagation test. Pass criteria are self-extinguishment within a specified length and no spread by flaming material transfer. Numeric conditions (sample length, pressure, O2 steps) not verified from the standard itself. Sample length reported as 30 cm in a search snippet only.

standards.name: Maximum oxygen concentration (MOC) concept
standards.summary: MOC is the highest oxygen concentration at which a set of samples (search snippet says a minimum of five) passes Test 1 at a fixed total pressure. MOC varies roughly linearly with total pressure for some materials per a NASA Glenn study (snippet, not fetched). Verify wording against NASA-STD-6001B.
